lead.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold historic trilateral
lead.deck: Nuclear arms and the Ukraine war are on the table as the three leaders meet on the APEC sidelines. Xi personally greeted Trump at the airport — a first for a foreign leader — with a fighter-jet flyover.

cards.headline: Anthropic's record IPO raises $107.3B
cards.caption: Priced at $83 a share, valued up to $1.5tn; stock debut Thursday — the biggest IPO ever, past SpaceX.

cards.headline: GTA VI launches after a 13-year wait
cards.caption: Rolls out from Asia and NZ to the UK; critics positive, launch-day glitches reported.

cards.headline: Crimean Bridge hit again; rail halted
cards.caption: Third attack this week on the Russia–Crimea link; traffic suspended, Russian officials say.

cards.headline: Israel pushes ground op past Yellow Line
cards.caption: Rare Gaza incursion to dismantle a 'terror tunnel'; Hamas calls it a flagrant ceasefire violation.

cards.headline: Myanmar faces genocide verdict at UN court
cards.caption: Rohingya case: no state has ever been found guilty of genocide by an international court.

cards.headline: Van Gogh fetches a record $190.4M
cards.caption: Châtaigniers en fleurs (1890) sells after a row over its Nazi-era history.

cards.headline: Fed minutes: almost all see more hikes
cards.caption: Hawkish October minutes lift the dollar and yields; gold sinks 3% to a 14-month low.

cards.headline: South Florida floods in torrential rain
cards.caption: Neighborhoods underwater; schools, roads, hospitals and airports disrupted.

cards.headline: Jeffries nominated for House Speaker
cards.caption: Democrats' pick puts him on path to be the first Black speaker when they take the House in January.

cards.headline: Musk: midterm spend 'pretty foolish'
cards.caption: The billionaire says he is 'not Maga', distancing himself from the movement linked to Trump.

cards.headline: Russian arrested spying on Palantir
cards.caption: Followed the US defence firm's employees; fake US IDs and two Russian passports found.

cards.headline: Bangladesh violence; Yunus home burned
cards.caption: Arson and blasts in Dhaka ahead of Sheikh Hasina's planned December return from India.
